description: This file defines the class AesGcmEncryptingStream, which implements stream encryption using AES-GCM mode for the AWS Crypto SDK. It manages encryption operations for data streams, allowing encryption with different key sizes and IVs, and supports backward compatibility with different PHP versions.

classes.name: AesGcmEncryptingStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of data to be encrypted using AES-GCM mode, supporting encryption setup and stream creation.

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns a static string for the AES/GCM/NoPadding algorithm name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encryption stream with provided plaintext stream, key, IV, AAD, tag length, and key size.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher method name based on key size.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES name, same as the static method, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the initialization vector used for encryption.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns an encrypted stream based on the current PHP version and configuration.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the authentication tag after encryption.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; always returns false.
